layer1.name: Pinboard
layer1.one_liner: Fast, no-nonsense bookmarking for people who read a lot.
layer1.description: A deliberately plain bookmarking service with full-text archiving, sold for a small annual fee. Launched into a category where the dominant free incumbent had just been acquired and neglected.
layer1.outcome_note: Profitable one-person business for over a decade. The founder published annual revenue, which ranged between roughly $117k and $259k a year from 2010 to 2020, on very low operating costs.

sources.note: Covers the business model, solo operation and published revenue history
